Basic reranking of documents against a query

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"documents\":[\"Machine learning is a subset of AI.\",\"The weather is sunny today.\",\"Deep learning uses neural networks.\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"What is machine learning?\"}", RerankRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.rerank(request)
    println(result)
}
```
